facts.text: Everybody wants to win. Even the kids. Especially me. Hand over the orange slices.
facts.why: Printed as a note from Phil. The quote page has Phil asking for juice boxes and pizzas, and nothing about orange slices, so the last line is invented behaviour.
facts.fix: Everybody wants to win. Even the kids. Especially me. Where are my juice boxes?
